name: Otake Sanjuurou
source:
He is owner of the employment agency and Haritsune's boss.

He stands at 5'5" (~168cm).

He used to be an owner of an Ochaya which had several prostitutes. He went out of business for treating the women poorly. Thanks to the quick thinking of Haritsune, his failed business was transformed into an employment agency.

He doesn't do anything in particular even though he is the owner. He simply drinks alcohol and smokes from his pipe during the day.

Just like Haritsune, he is viewed as dangerous by those around him. He is rumored to capture young girls and sell them as prostitutes.

He is bossy, overbearing, unfriendly and incompetent.
